title: Hyprland Configuration
description: JSON Schema for Hyprland compositor configuration (hyprland.conf). Note: Hyprland uses its own config syntax, not JSON. This schema is intended for use with editor tooling (e.g. Neovim LSP, VS Code) via a JSON/YAML bridge or a custom language server.

monitor.description: Monitor configuration entries. Each entry is a string in the format: 'name, resolution@hz, position, scale' or 'name, preferred, auto, scale'. Use 'auto' for automatic. Example: 'DP-1, 2560x1440@144, 0x0, 1'.

exec-once.description: Commands to execute once on startup. Prefix with '[workspace N silent]' to launch on a specific workspace.

exec.description: Commands to execute on every config reload.

env.description: Environment variables to set. Format: 'VARIABLE, value'. Example: 'XCURSOR_SIZE, 24'.

border_size.description: Size of window borders in pixels.

gaps_in.description: Inner gaps between windows in pixels.

gaps_out.description: Outer gaps between windows and monitor edges in pixels.

gaps_workspaces.description: Gaps between workspaces. Stacks on top of gaps_out.

col.active_border.description: Border color for the active window. Accepts rgba(), rgb(), or gradient.

col.nogroup_border.description: Border color for windows not in a group.

col.nogroup_border_active.description: Border color for the active window not in a group.

no_focus_fallback.description: If true, will not fall back to the next available window when the focused one is closed.

resize_on_border.description: Enables resizing windows by clicking and dragging on borders and gaps.

extend_border_grab_area.description: Extends the area around the border where you can click and drag to resize, when resize_on_border is on.

hover_icon_on_border.description: Show a cursor icon when hovering over borders, when resize_on_border is on.

allow_tearing.description: Master switch for allowing tearing to occur. See the Tearing page for more details.

window_gap.description: Minimum gap in pixels between windows before snapping.

monitor_gap.description: Minimum gap in pixels between window and monitor edges before snapping.

border_overlap.description: If true, snapped window borders will overlap.

decoration.description: Window decoration settings (rounding, shadows, opacity, blur).

rounding_power.description: Power of the rounding curve. 2 = circular, higher = squircle-ish.

shadow_ignore_window.description: If true, the shadow will not render behind the window itself.

col.shadow_inactive.description: Shadow color for inactive windows. Unset = same as col.shadow.

shadow_scale.description: Shadow scale relative to window size.

dim_special.description: How much to dim the rest of the screen when a special workspace is open.

dim_around.description: How much to dim the rest of the screen when using 'dimaround' window rule.

screen_shader.description: Path to a custom GLSL shader for the entire screen.

passes.description: Number of blur passes. More passes = smoother but more GPU load.

ignore_opacity.description: Make the blur ignore window opacity.

xray.description: If true, blurred windows will always blur the actual desktop content, ignoring windows layered between.

noise.description: Noise strength added to the blur for a more organic look.

vibrancy.description: Vibrancy (color saturation boost) for the blur.

special.description: Whether to blur the background of special workspaces.

popups.description: Whether to blur popups (tooltips, menus, etc.).

popups_ignorealpha.description: Ignore popup blur below this opacity.

bezier.description: Custom bezier curve definitions. Format: 'name, x0, y0, x1, y1'.

animation.description: Animation rules. Format: 'name, on/off, speed, curve [,style]'. Example: 'windows, 1, 7, myBezier, slide'.

kb_layout.description: XKB keyboard layout. Comma-separated for multiple.

kb_file.description: Path to an XKB file to use.

repeat_rate.description: Key repeat rate in keys per second.

scroll_button.description: Mouse button used for scrolling when scroll_method is 'button'.

scroll_button_lock.description: If true, the scroll button doesn't need to be held down.

focus_on_close.description: Controls focus after window close. 0=next in history, 1=window under cursor.

mouse_refocus.description: If disabled, mouse focus won't switch to the hovered window unless keyboard focus has already changed.

float_switch_override_focus.description: Override focus when switching to/from a floating window.

special_fallthrough.description: If true, clicking on an empty space in a special workspace falls through to the regular workspace.

off_window_axis_events.description: How to handle events off window axis.

emulate_discrete_scroll.description: Whether to emulate discrete scroll events for high-res touchpads.

middle_button_emulation.description: Emulate middle button by simultaneous left+right click.

clickfinger_behavior.description: Enable clickfinger behavior (button determined by number of fingers).

output.description: Output to bind the touchscreen to.
Output to bind the tablet to.

region_size.description: Region size as 'width height' vec2. 0 0 = entire surface.

relative_input.description: Use relative input (like a mouse) instead of absolute.

left_handed.description: Enable left-handed mode for the tablet.

active_area_position.description: Active area position as 'x y' vec2.

active_area_size.description: Active area size as 'width height' vec2.

workspace_swipe_fingers.description: Number of fingers for workspace swipe.

workspace_swipe_min_fingers.description: If enabled, workspace swipe triggers with workspace_swipe_fingers or more.

workspace_swipe_distance.description: Distance in pixels to swipe to change workspace.

workspace_swipe_min_speed_to_force.description: Minimum speed (pixels/s) to force a workspace switch during swipe.

workspace_swipe_cancel_ratio.description: If the swipe goes back this ratio of the way, cancel the switch.

workspace_swipe_create_new.description: Create a new workspace when swiping past the last one.

workspace_swipe_direction_lock.description: Lock the swipe direction once determined.

workspace_swipe_direction_lock_threshold.description: Distance threshold in pixels to determine swipe direction.

workspace_swipe_forever.description: Don't cancel workspace swipe when releasing fingers — keep following swipe until release.

workspace_swipe_use_r.description: Use workspace_swipe_fingers for switching in the r-direction.

insert_after_current.description: Whether new windows in a group are inserted after the current tab.

focus_removed_window.description: Whether to focus the window that was removed from the group.

drag_into_group.description: Dragging a window into a group. 0=disabled, 1=enabled, 2=drop only into head.

merge_groups_on_drag.description: Merge groups when one is dragged onto another.

merge_floated_into_tiled_on_groupbar.description: Auto-merge floating windows dragged onto tiled group bars.

col.border_locked_active.description: Border color for locked active groups.

col.border_locked_inactive.description: Border color for locked inactive groups.

font_size.description: Font size for groupbar tab titles.

height.description: Height of the groupbar in pixels.

stacked.description: Stack the groupbar at the top of the window.

render_titles.description: Render window titles in the groupbar.

scrolling.description: Allow scrolling through tabs in the groupbar.

col.active.description: Active tab color in the groupbar.

col.inactive.description: Inactive tab color in the groupbar.

col.locked_active.description: Active locked tab color in the groupbar.

col.locked_inactive.description: Inactive locked tab color in the groupbar.

disable_hyprland_logo.description: Disable the random Hyprland logo/anime girl background on empty workspaces.

disable_splash_rendering.description: Disable the splash text above the logo.

font_family.description: Default font family used in Hyprland's own UI (e.g. groupbar, hyprland-error).

splash_font_family.description: Font family for the splash text. Falls back to font_family.

force_default_wallpaper.description: Force which default wallpaper to display. 0/1/2 for a specific, -1 for random.

vfr.description: Enable variable frame rate. Reduces resource usage when idle.

mouse_move_enables_dpms.description: Wake monitors from DPMS sleep on mouse movement.

key_press_enables_dpms.description: Wake monitors from DPMS sleep on key press.

always_follow_on_dnd.description: Always follow the window when dragging.

layers_hog_keyboard_focus.description: If true, keyboard focus will go to interactive layer surfaces (e.g. wlogout).

animate_mouse_windowdragging.description: Animate window dragging with the mouse.

disable_autoreload.description: Disable automatic config reload on file change.

enable_swallow.description: Enable window swallowing (terminal swallows child window).

swallow_regex.description: Regex matching window class names that should swallow their children.

swallow_exception_regex.description: Regex matching window title exceptions for swallowing.

focus_on_activate.description: Automatically focus windows that request activation.

mouse_move_focuses_monitor.description: Moving mouse to a monitor focuses it.

render_ahead_of_time.description: Experimental: Render a frame slightly ahead of time.

render_ahead_safezone.description: Extra ms of safezone for render_ahead_of_time.

allow_session_lock_restore.description: Allow restoring a session lock if the locking app crashes.

background_color.description: Background color when no wallpaper is set.

close_special_on_empty.description: Close special workspace when the last window is moved out.

new_window_takes_over_fullscreen.description: Behavior when a new window opens on a fullscreen workspace. 0=no effect, 1=unfullscreen, 2=fullscreen new window.

exit_window_retains_fullscreen.description: Whether fullscreen state is retained when exiting a fullscreen window.

initial_workspace_tracking.description: How workspaces are tracked on startup. 0=no tracking, 1=monocle, 2=by last.

disable_xdg_env_checks.description: Disable checks for required XDG environment variables.

pass_mouse_when_bound.description: Pass mouse events to the window even when a bind uses them.

scroll_event_delay.description: Delay in ms between scroll event and next bind trigger.

workspace_back_and_forth.description: Toggling the same workspace key switches back to the previous workspace.

allow_workspace_cycles.description: Allow workspace cycling (wrapping past first/last workspace).

workspace_center_on.description: Which monitor to center the cursor on when switching workspace. 0=last active, 1=middle.

focus_preferred_method.description: Preferred method to focus the next window. 0=history, 1=length.

ignore_group_lock.description: Binds to move to next/prev in group ignore group lock.

disable_keybind_grabbing.description: Disable keybind grabbing (useful for KVM / nested compositors).

window_direction_monitor_fallback.description: Move focus/window to the next monitor when hitting workspace edge.

use_nearest_neighbor.description: Use nearest-neighbor scaling for XWayland windows (avoids blurry scaling).

force_zero_scaling.description: Force XWayland to use 1x scaling (can fix HiDPI issues with legacy apps).

nvidia_anti_flicker.description: Enable NVIDIA-specific flickering fix (minor performance hit).

sync_gsettings_theme.description: Sync cursor theme and size with gsettings.

no_hardware_cursors.description: Disable hardware cursor planes (use software rendering). Required for some NVIDIA setups.

no_break_fs_vrr.description: Do not break fullscreen VRR when the cursor moves.

min_refresh_rate.description: Minimum refresh rate for the cursor.

hotspot_padding.description: Hotspot padding (pixels from screen edge where cursor hotspot activates).

inactive_timeout.description: Seconds before cursor hides when inactive. 0 = never.

no_warps.description: Disable cursor warps (teleportation) when switching focus.

persistent_warps.description: When focus changes to a different monitor, warp cursor to the focused window on the new monitor.

warp_on_change_workspace.description: Warp cursor to the focused window when changing workspaces.

default_monitor.description: Default monitor to place cursor on startup.

zoom_rigid.description: Whether the zoom region is rigid (centered) or follows the cursor.

hide_on_key_press.description: Hide cursor when a key is pressed.

hide_on_touch.description: Hide cursor when touching the touchscreen.

allow_dumb_copy.description: Allow direct cursor copy (for some NVIDIA setups).

use_cpu_buffer.description: Use CPU buffer for cursor. 0=off, 1=on, 2=auto (NVIDIA only).

pseudotile.description: Enable pseudotiling (keep the window's original floating size when tiling).

force_split.description: Split direction override. 0=follow cursor, 1=always left/top, 2=always right/bottom.

preserve_split.description: If true, the split direction does not change when windows are closed/moved.

smart_split.description: If true, splits based on the window size to always maximize area.

smart_resizing.description: Smart resizing: resize neighbor window as well.

permanent_direction_override.description: If force_split override lasts permanently or only for the next split.

special_scale_factor.description: Scale factor for special workspaces in dwindle.

split_width_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to determine how wide a window should be split.

no_gaps_when_only.description: Remove gaps/borders when only one window on workspace. 0=off, 1=no gaps, 2=no gaps+borders.

use_active_for_splits.description: New split uses the active window (not largest).

allow_small_split.description: Allow splitting even when master takes up less than half the screen.

special_scale_factor.description: Scale factor for special workspace in master layout.

new_status.description: Status of the new window. master=always master, slave=always slave, inherit=match focused.

new_on_top.description: New windows open at the top of the slave stack.

new_on_active.description: Where new slave windows are inserted relative to the active slave.

no_gaps_when_only.description: Remove gaps/borders when only one window on workspace. 0=off, 1=no gaps, 2=no gaps+borders.

inherit_fullscreen.description: Inherit fullscreen state from the slave.

smart_resizing.description: Resize neighbor window when resizing master.

drop_at_cursor.description: When dragging a window, place it at the cursor position.

windowrule.description: Window rules (legacy single-param format). Format: 'rule, class_regex'. Prefer windowrulev2.

windowrulev2.description: Window rules v2 (multi-param format). Format: 'rule, class:regex, title:regex, ...'.

workspace.description: Workspace rules. Format: 'id, rules...' e.g. '1, monitor:DP-1, default:true'.

binde.description: Repeating keybinds (held key repeats). Same format as bind.

bindn.description: Non-consuming keybinds (passes through to window). Same format as bind.

bindl.description: Locked keybinds (work even when screen is locked). Same format as bind.

bindr.description: Release keybinds (trigger on key release). Same format as bind.

bindel.description: Repeating + locked keybind combo. Same format as bind.

device.description: Per-device input configuration. Uses the device's hyprctl name.

name.description: Device name as reported by hyprctl devices.

plugin.description: Plugin-specific configuration blocks. Structure depends on each plugin.

$.description: Variable definition. Format: '$varname = value'. Accessed as $varname elsewhere.
